roles.name: Member 1 - Frontend and reporting
roles.mission: Make one clear phone-friendly journey from image selection to a reviewed report and copied complaint.
roles.reviewer: M4 checks the full journey; M2 checks request contracts. Role slots are unassigned.

tasks.title: Agree the screens and shared inputs
steps: Agree the draft, review and public-report types with M2; use M3's labeled fixtures.
Sketch upload -> review -> published screens; reserve a client-only map slot for M4.
tasks.done: M2 and M4 accept the component props and sample payload; role ownership is recorded.
tasks.handoff: Send screen props and needed API fields to M2/M4.

tasks.title: Build photo and location input
steps: Add one JPEG/PNG/WebP file input, preview and a clear 3 MB size limit; reject an unsupported or oversized file.
Collect latitude/longitude with a map pin or editable coordinates. Offer geolocation only with manual fallback.
tasks.done: A supported photo and corrected location can be submitted; denied GPS and invalid files show useful messages.
tasks.handoff: M2 receives the agreed multipart payload; M4 receives the selected-location props.

tasks.title: Complete mandatory review at the H3 gate
steps: Submit with the anonymous session token; show loading and failure without claiming a draft was saved on error.
Render editable labels, description and location with live/manual/sample labels; wire a separate explicit Publish confirmation to M2's route.
tasks.done: The H3 slice persists a reviewed report and refreshes M4's map; failed saving and unconfirmed drafts never appear as published success.
tasks.handoff: Run the H3 slice with M2/M4 and record the remaining blocker, if any.

tasks.title: Publish once and create complaint text
steps: Call M2's publish route for the same draft ID; disable repeated clicks and show success only after persistence succeeds.
Explain that confirmed description and selected coordinates become public while the photo stays private; add editable complaint text and Copy.
tasks.done: A reviewed report survives reload and appears on M4's map; copying uses confirmed fields and never sends a complaint.
tasks.handoff: M4 runs the complete H5 journey; M2 gets exact error cases.

tasks.title: Check the deployed phone journey
steps: Run the final HTTPS URL on a phone with one supported photo, manual coordinates, review, publish and complaint copy.
Fix only blockers: unreadable controls, denied GPS, failed upload, unavailable AI, publish error and sample labeling.
tasks.done: A teammate completes the phone flow; a failed operation never shows false success and public-data wording is visible.
tasks.handoff: Give M4 the verified phone/browser and any limitations before H7 freeze.

tasks.title: Freeze screens and support rehearsal
steps: Merge reviewed UI work, record the deployed commit and avoid new features after H7.
Help capture a backup and rehearse the active live/manual/sample mode; attach actual evidence to the workstream Issue.
tasks.done: The UI used in rehearsal matches the frozen deployment; incomplete work stays unchecked and every shown mode is labeled.
tasks.handoff: M4 receives the final URL, known limits and backup assets.

roles.name: Member 4 - Map, integration and demo
roles.mission: Join the workstreams into a credible map demonstration and keep the eight-hour gates visible.
roles.owns: components/map/*; integration-checks/*; docs/demo.md; GitHub workstream tracking
roles.reviewer: M1 checks map usability; M2 checks public fields. Role slots are unassigned.

tasks.title: Set the eight-hour gates and map boundary
steps: Record who fills M1-M4 after the team agrees; prepare four workstream Issues without inventing assignments.
Agree public map props with M1/M2, prepare small visibly labeled fixtures and display H1/H3/H5/H7/H8 gates.
tasks.done: Each role slot is assigned by the team or clearly unassigned; shared map/report types and gate times are visible.
tasks.handoff: All roles get Issue links and the next integration time.

tasks.title: Build a pins-only public map
steps: Render React Leaflet client-side with OpenStreetMap attribution; show published pins with confirmed description, labels, time and source.
Make real reports the default; put is_demo fixtures in a separate Sample view. Provide empty/error state and a Refresh action.
tasks.done: Fixtures render without SSR errors, sample badges are visible, and private fields/photos are not required.
tasks.handoff: M1 receives the map component; M2 receives public GET expectations.

tasks.title: Run the H3 integration gate
steps: Connect M1's map slot to M2's public GET and refresh after publication; do not add background polling or hotspots.
Run upload -> manual/sample review -> publish -> reload -> map with all roles and record the first failing boundary.
tasks.done: A persisted manual flow reaches the map, or the exact missing boundary is documented as prototype-only progress.
tasks.handoff: Send each blocker to its role owner; pause polish until the slice works.

tasks.title: Accept the H5 core or lock the fallback
steps: Run the complete flow including complaint Copy; record whether analysis was live, manual_fallback or sample/mock.
Check with M2 that another session cannot publish the draft and a private draft is absent from public GET.
tasks.done: The end-to-end persisted flow passes, with live AI or a truthful manual fallback; unresolved core gaps are named.
tasks.handoff: Tell all roles the frozen demo mode and only the blockers remaining before H7.

tasks.title: Freeze after phone and privacy checks
steps: Run the small QA matrix on the deployed URL, including phone upload, denied GPS, AI failure, repeat publish and sample separation.
Draft a three-minute rehearsal script around one report; keep the six-slide selection deck framed as a proposal until implementation is verified.
tasks.done: Evidence and limitations are attached; the team freezes at 17:00 with an honest script and no new features.
tasks.handoff: M1/M2/M3 receive the final blocker list and judging order.

tasks.title: Rehearse and package the demo
steps: Rehearse once on the frozen deployment and prepare a labeled recording/screenshots if the network fails.
Record actual implementation status, URL/commit and uncompleted tasks; follow the announced submission rules at 18:00.
tasks.done: The team is ready at 18:00 and can clearly separate working software, fallback behavior, samples and future plans.
tasks.handoff: All four members receive the demo script, backup and known limitations.
